title: nf-core/mxampseq pipeline - params.analysis_setup schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.analysis_setup: a list of targets and their analysis settings

target.errorMessage: Target name is required, may only contain letters, digits and '-', and 'unknown' is reserved for reads matching no target

forward_primer.errorMessage: Forward primer is required and must be an IUPAC sequence without X anchors

reverse_primer.errorMessage: Reverse primer is required and must be an IUPAC sequence without X anchors

clustering.errorMessage: Clustering must be one of cluster_fast, cluster_size, cluster_smallmem, cluster_unoise

clustering_params.errorMessage: clustering_params may only contain letters, digits, spaces and . = _ - and must not set --sizein, --sizeout, --consout, --threads, output flags or a cluster_* algorithm
